propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger at module level, preventing log records from reaching pytest's caplog handler in subsequent tests within the same process
caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently with StopIteration or empty record lists when they execute after configure_logging() has run, but pass in isolation or when run before the call
the failure is non-deterministic and order-dependent: the same test suite passes or fails depending on which worker executes configure_logging() first under parallel test distribution
the propagate=False mutation is process-global and never restored, affecting every caplog-asserting test that runs after the poisoning in the same worker
removing propagate=False from configure_logging() is safe because uvicorn does not add root handlers and the marker-guarded handler prevents duplication without relying on propagation blocking
